instruction: A cinematic still with natural colors and a shallow depth of field captures a medium shot of four children standing in an outdoor park with green trees in the background. On the far left, the boy wearing glasses and a light yellow t-shirt (R3) stands with his right arm over the shoulder of the girl next to him, looking at the camera with a slight smile. Next to him, the girl with curly hair tied up, wearing a white cardigan over a reddish-brown jumpsuit (R1), stands with her arms around the shoulders of the boys on either side, looking forward with a gentle, calm smile. The boy in the blue denim button-up shirt (R4) stands second from the right, smiling warmly. On the far right, the girl with dark hair and bangs, wearing a dark blue cardigan over a striped dress (R2), stands with her left arm wrapped around his waist, smiling happily. Bright, warm sunlight filters through the trees from behind, creating a soft backlighting effect.
elements: R3 places his right arm over R1's shoulder
R1 has her arms around the shoulders of R3 and R4
R2 wraps her left arm around R4's waist
R4 is the boy whose waist is being held by R2
the children are standing in an outdoor park with green trees behind them
